item.title: NYC Ferries are becoming floating classrooms for thousands of students
item.description: The nonprofit Billion Oyster Project has partnered with New York’s ferry system to teach students about the harbor and marine careers. On weekday mornings, thousands of New Yorkers traverse the city by ferry. Thirty eight boats in the city’s fleet criss-cross the East River, travel up the Hudson, or loop around the bottom of Brooklyn to the Rockaways in order to bring people to work or school. In a city surrounded by water, the ferry is just another way to commute....

item.title: People can’t stop trolling AI job ‘interviewers’
item.description: Comedy videos online highlight the awkward shortcomings of AI avatars that could screen job applicants. AI is conducting job interviews more and more widely. And while it may be anxiety-inducing for some—as they attempt to figure out what a robot deems hirable—others are rage-baiting the technology for the lolz in skits online.
